cc:Work.dc:title: Normal connection and compact-frame descent
cc:Work.dc:description:
LF.4–LF.6, GJ.1–GJ.5, FD.1–FD.7. Exact algebra, typed schematics and explicitly conditional sampled bounds.
# Component terms
The original diagram, mathematical expressions, drawing instructions, exact finite checks and solutions are dedicated under CC0 1.0, to the extent of rights held. The [complete CC0 dedication](../labelled-geometric-kernel/LICENSE-CC0.txt) accompanies the shared course resources. Human sources retain their terms.
The drawing reads the unchanged DejaVu fonts in the adjacent labelled-geometric-kernel folder. Their full terms are retained in that folder's FONT-NOTICE.txt. Python, Matplotlib, NumPy and Pillow are required rather than bundled; their complete notices accompany the shared pinned requirements in that folder's software-notices directory.
